_comment: Copy to ~/.asmltr/media-allow.json (or set ASMLTR_MEDIA_ALLOW_FILE). Principal ids must match trust store principals.id — placeholders only, never real names. discordIds are numeric Discord user ids; leave empty in git and fill locally. photoAllow / imageAllow: stills + asmltr post, not video. videoAllow: clips AND stills. mediaAllow: both. codeAllow: write-a-program for that caller. Empty list = owner/bypass only. photoAllow / imageAllow here are example format only (not a public stills gate). leave videoAllow empty unless you want clips. Same-guild Discord post is NOT this file — that is trusted role or resolve() allow (see seed.example.json).
